lines.t: You keep talking about the fire, but my hands are so cold
Preaching by all the branches while the roots take hold
I've been dressing up my cold pen like it's self-control
All this smoke in my lungs from a starving soul
You don't stare at the bottle, you're staring at the well
You don't blame all the symptoms, you're reading what they tell
Every habit is a language that my wounds can spell
You're not here to drag me, you're here to break the spell
You go for the high, not the high
Cut off the cords I've been calling my life
Tear down the idols I keep inside
Till the lust and the craving run dry
You go for the high, not the high
Love is the blade and the healer this time
Oh, I'm walking out of the dark, I hide
Cause you go for the heart, not the eye
I've been sleeping in a temple that I built of lies
All the neon on my skin, but I'm dead inside
All these pretty little poisons that I romanticize
But you rip between the lines in my bloodshot eyes
You don't fix up the branches on a dying tree
You put your hands in the dirt where the roots can't breathe
Pull the thorns in the doctrine out of my beliefs
Turn my coping into crying, crying into peace
You go for the high, not the high
Cut off the cords I've been calling my life Tear down the idols I keep inside
Till the lust and the craving run dry You go for the high, not the high
Love is the blade and the healer this time I'm walking out of the dark
Cause you go for the heart, not the heart
Strip my pride, burn my disguise
Let every demoted come to light
If I lose my world to be made alive
Then let it die, let it die, let it die
Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
You go for the hard, not the hard
